---
title: "lowpoly-pdf-to-svg"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-index
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
```

Turns low poly papercraft PDF templates into one Inkscape SVG, ready for review and Cricut Design Space. Every piece becomes a group with its cut outline, score lines for the folds and pen-drawn edge numbers, tagged with its cardstock colour.

```bash
make install
make            # data/example/example.pdf -> data/example/example.svg
```

The first template is the Bowser mask. The [Results](sheets.qmd) pages summarise whether the printed edge numbers pair up into [glue edges](glue-pairs.qmd) of the same length and whether the pieces close when [folded up in 3D](fold3d.qmd). The traced sheets themselves are the creator's pattern, so they appear only in a local build (`make preview`).

## The model

The Bowser papercraft mask is by [Sweets The Cat](https://sweetsthecat.itch.io/) (also credited as Papercraft Cat), made as a Halloween project and free for personal use. This repository does not include or redistribute the PDF; check the creator's current terms before sharing derived files. A community mirror is on [Paperzone VN](https://paperzonevn.com/bowser-mask.t13095/).

## Where it stands

```{r}
#| label: status-summary
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(NUMBERS)) {
  cat(sprintf("%d sheets, %d printed edge numbers on %d pieces: **%d matching**, **%d need work**.\n",
              stat("pages"), stat("numbers"), stat("pieces"), stat("matching"), stat("needs_work")))
} else {
  cat("No summary statistics are committed yet (`make report-data`).\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-status
#| fig-cap: "Printed edge numbers by check result. Only *ok* means both edges were found and their lengths agree."
#| fig-height: 3.2
status <- stat_table("status")
if (!is.null(status)) {
  status |>
    mutate(status = fct_reorder(status, n)) |>
    ggplot(aes(n, status, fill = verdict)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = VERDICT_COLOURS) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(x = "edge numbers", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_hi() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sheets
#| tbl-cap: "Edge numbers per sheet, worst first."
pages <- stat_table("pages")
if (!is.null(pages)) {
  pages |>
    transmute(Page = sprintf("%02d", page), Cardstock = cardstock, Matching = matching,
              `Needs work` = needs_work,
              `Share ok` = scales::percent(matching / (matching + needs_work), accuracy = 1)) |>
    arrange(desc(`Needs work` / (Matching + `Needs work`))) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "llrrr")
}
```
